notes.title: Something New is Entering the Ring… 👀
notes.content: [h3]Hey everyone! [/h3][p]While we continue to support and love this game, we’ve also been hard at work on something brand new… and a little strange.[/p][p]Our next project is called Realm of Fame, a wrestling roguelike full of over-the-top action, chaotic moves, and endless runs where no two fights are ever the same.[/p][p]We’ll be sharing more updates very soon, but for now, you can already check out the game’s Steam page and add it to your Wishlist to catch every announcement from day one.[/p][p]🛒 [url="https//store.steampowered.com/app/3310030/Realm_of_Fame"]Wishlist Realm of Fame on Steam[/url][/p][p]Thanks for being part of our journey, your support means the world and helps us push forward with every new project. 💙[/p]

notes.title: The Tale of Bistun takes part in the Isometric RPG Sale 2025
notes.content: [h3]Hey there, TToB Community![/h3][p][/p][p]We're happy to announce that [b]The Tale of Bistun[/b] is taking part in the [b]Isometric RPG Sale 2025[/b] which begins on August 11th! The event is a fantastic opportunity to dive into some of the best top-down RPGs on Steam, and we're happy and excited to be a part of it.[/p][p][/p][p]We're also bundled up with an amazing RPG from Fool's Theory - Seven: Enhanced Edition[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/57997/Seven_Enhanced_Edition_x_The_Tale_of_Bistun/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]The [b]Isometric RPG Sale 2025[/b] starts on [b]August 11[/b] and ends on [b]August 18[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Happy gaming![/p][p][/p]
